questions.q: Complete with the correct inversion: “Never again ____ such a mistake.”
questions.why: 'Never' at the start is followed by auxiliary + subject + verb. Like GPSC CBRT, Mar 2026.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “The doctor prescribed rest ____ a week.”
questions.why: A period of time takes 'for'. GPSC-style practice item.

opts: Seldom did I have met so honest an officer.
Seldom have I met so honest an officer.
Seldom have met I so honest an officer.
Seldom I have met so honest an officer.
questions.why: Negative adverbs (seldom, never, rarely) at the start take auxiliary + subject. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: “They ____ married since 2005.”
questions.why: 'Since' + a point in time takes the present perfect. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “My scissors ____ very sharp.”
questions.why: 'Scissors' is a plural noun and takes a plural verb. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “He is married ____ my cousin.”
questions.why: 'Married to' is the fixed form. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Select the correct indirect speech: She asked me, “Where do you live?”
opts: She asked me where I lived.
She asked me where did I live.
She asked me where do I live.
She asked me that where I lived.
questions.why: Reported questions use statement word order and no 'that'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “He is accused ______ taking a bribe.”
questions.why: 'Accused of'; but 'charged with'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the meaning of the idiom “to cost an arm and a leg”:
questions.why: The idiom means to be very costly. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Select the correct indirect speech: He said, “I am tired.”
opts: He said that he was tired.
He said that I was tired.
He said that he is tired.
He said that he had been tired yesterday.
questions.why: Reporting verb in the past: am → was; I → he. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
